others.spellCheckDesc: Fexe ba say thread di saytu ortograafi.
others.resetFactoryDesc: Delloosi aplikaasioŋ bi ci anam wimu njëkkoon, efaase bépp model ak jaar-jaaru waxtaan. Jëf jooju mënul soppiku, te dañu koy digal sudee aplikaasioŋ bi dafa yàqu.

shortcuts.toggleSidebarDesc: Wane wala nëbb barre de côté.
shortcuts.switchAssistantDesc: Demal ci assistant bi ci topp ci waxtaan wi.

interface.title: Jaay
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Fu yëgle toast yi di feeñ. Ci Windows, default bi mingi ci suufu ndeyjoor suko defee popup yi duñu muur doxalinu palanteer bi.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Wane ay token/sec ak lim token yi ci suufu mesaasu ndimbalkat yi. Suñu ko fay, ikon bu dëgër bi dafay wane leeral yi ci klike bi.
interface.coloredUserBubble: Bubble mesaas jëfandikukat bu am melo
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Jëfandikool melo aksan bi ci ginaaw say mesaas. Suñu ko defee, dañuy méngale bataaxal assistant yi ak mbind mu leer ci kaw lëndëm gu amul benn boor.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Yokk benn lëkkalekaay ci kodu HTML ak SVG. HTML dafay doxal xët wi model bi defar ci biir benn kadre sandbox buy def ay script boppam waaye mënul dugg ci Novera, say dosie wala reso bi; SVG dafay wane ci anam wu taxawul te skript yi deñu dellu ginaaw. Def ci default.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Dafay tënk ci saasi waxtaan yu bees yi ci benn tur thread. Def ko ngir denc titre bi fiy baaxoo nekk ba nga soppi tur wi ci sa bopp.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Defar melo lëmu palantu aplikaasioŋ bi.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Defar melo lëmu barabu ëmbiit bu mag bi.
interface.primaryDesc: Defar melo bi njëkk ngir aksan interfaas bi.
interface.accentDesc: Tannal melo aksan bi ñuy jëfandikoo ci UI.
interface.destructiveDesc: Def melo relimination ngir jëf yuy yàq.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Defaraat bépp jekkal interface ci anam wi ñu ko jagleel.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Bépp jekkal interface delloo nañu ko ci fimu nekkoon.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Tannal ni chat viewport bi wara def su mesaas yu bees yegsee.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Dafay tëye viewport bi ci mesaas bi mujjee yónnee.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Dafay topp ci saasi ni tontu yi di jaar ci saa si.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Waneel kontëru jeton ci biir duggal waxtaan. Suñu ko deactiwe, kontëru token bi dafay feeñ ci suufu dugal bi.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Waneel nimero liiñ yi ci bloku kod yi.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Reset kodu bloku stil ci default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Kodu bloku stil reset bi jaarna yoon
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Delloosi nañu stil bloke kode bi fimu nekkoon.

hardware.name: Tur
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Jëfandikool Vulkan API ngir gaawaay GPU. Bul tàmbali Vulkan sudee am nga NVIDIA GPU ndax mën na indi jafe-jafe deggoo.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Amul benn GPU buñuy gis ci motëru llama.cpp. Modèle yi dina ñu daw ci CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: No llama.cpp di waxtaan ak GPU
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Jëfandikool API bii ngir GPU bii
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU bokk nañu benn poolu mémoire ak CPU — model yi dañuy jëlee ci benn mémoire bi yeneen sistem yi am.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: Sa GPU yi soppiku nañu, moo tax motëru dëkk bi tàmbaliwaat. Modèle yi dañuy sarsewaat ci jëfandikoo gi ci topp.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: Sa GPU yi soppiku nañu, waaye benn model defa jaxasoo. Taxawal ko, nga bës Feresal ngir jëfandikoo GPU bu bees bi.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL ak portu sa serwëru proxy.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Ay leeral ngir serwëru proxy bi, su ko jaree.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Limu host yiñ tàqale ay virgule ngir moytu proxy bi.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc:
Nangu sertifikaa yi siñe seen bopp wala yuñu xool bu baax. Loolu mën nañu ko soxla ci yenn proxy yi waaye dafay wàññi kaaraange gi. Soo wóolu sa proxy rek nga mëna ko may.
0034
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Saytu sertifikaa SSL sooy boole ak proxy bi.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Saytu sertifikaa SSL bu njaatige proxy bi.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Saytu SSL sertifikaa yi lëkkaloog peer.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Saytu SSL sertifikaa yi ci host yiy dem.

webSearch.title: Seetug Web
webSearch.description: May model yi seetee ak jàng ci web bi jëfandikoo jumtukaayi Novera yiñ tabax ci biir.
webSearch.enableDesc: Piblisiteel jumtukaayi web_search ak web_fetch ci model yiy jàppale jëfandikoo jumtukaay. Dafay liggéey ci bitti boyet bi te amul caabi API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Tannal backend biy tontu web_search ak web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Faawu. Defal ab caabi {{provider}} API ngir am njëg yu gëna kawe ak njariñ yu jaar yoon. Bàyyileen amul dara ngir jëfandikoo endpoint bu amul caabi.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Dafay laaj. {{provider}} soxla caabi API ngir mëna delloosi njariñ yi.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Dafay laaj. Base URL bu sa misaalu {{provider}}, ak JSON API buñ taal.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Taxawal surfaasu agent Cowork: couche sandboxed, boole ci fàttaliku ak xam-xam yiñ denc ba fàww ci sa dosiye done Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Komànd yi {{backend}} tënk: mën nañu bind ci biir barabu liggéeyu sesioŋ bi, te fichier yi ci sa dosiye kër mënu leen jàng.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Amul benn sandbox ci sistem bii, moo tax jumtukaayu shell bi amul. Komànd yi duñu musa dox te kenn du leen tënk.
cowork.networkDesc: Bàyyil komand Cowork yegg ci reso bi, ngir mbir yu melni samp ay kofre wala jël ab dencukaay. Taal ci default. Shell chat bu mag bi musul am access ci reso bi.
cowork.noMemories: Ba tay amul ay fàttaliku. Model yi dañu leen di yokk ci jumtukaayu memory_write ndax dañu jàng mbir yu jara tëye.
cowork.noSkills: Ba tay amul xam-xam. Skill mooy xeetu tegtal buñ mëna jëfandikoowaat, model bi mën ko sarse suñu ko laajee.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Benn topic ci note bu nekk. Modèle yi dañu leen jàngaat ak jumtukaayu memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown tegtal, soo ko bëggee ak ay leeral ci YAML ci kanam. Tegtal bi mooy li model yi di gis balaa ñuy charger skill bi.

localApiServer.title: Serveur API
localApiServer.description: Doxal ab serwër bu méngoo ak OpenAI ci dëkk bi.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Xoolal log yi ci serwëru API bi ci dëkk bi.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Su aplikaasioŋ bi tàmbalee tàmbali Serveur API bi ci saasi.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Su palanteer bi tëjoo, dangay bàyyi serwër bi di dox ci biir tegukaayu sistem bi. Suñu ko defee, tëj palanteer bi dafay bàyyi Novera ba noppi dakkal serwër bi.
localApiServer.apiPrefixDesc: Njiitu yoon ngir poñ yu mujj API.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Xaarandi laaj yi ak caabi API.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Host yi mën nañu dugg ci serwër bi, ñu tàqale leen ay virgule.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Nangu laajte yu wuute ci serwëru API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Aktiwise journal serwër bu leer ngir debug.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Waxtu xaar tontu ci modelu dëkk bi, segond.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Modèle local buy sarse ci saasi su serwër bi tàmbalee.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Ngir jàppale nu gëna suqali Novera, mën nga séddoo ay done yu nëbbu lu melni jëfandikoo man-man ak limu jëfandikukat yi. Dunu musa jël say chat wala say leerali bopp.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Yaa ngi yor sa done yépp. Nekk leen ci sunu Politigu Njaboot.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Ngir gëna baaxal Novera, fàww nu xam ni ñu koy jëfandikoo—waaye ci sa ndimbal kese. Mën nga soppi jekkal bii saa yu la neexee.
privacy.privacyPromises: Sa tànneef fii du soppi sunuy dige yu am solo ci wàllu kumpa:
privacy.promise1: Say waxtaan nekk ci nëbbu ak ci sa aparey
privacy.promise2: Dunu musa jël say leerali bopp wala ëmbiitu waxtaan
privacy.promise3: Bépp séddoo done du nëbbu te dafay boole
privacy.promise4: Mën nga ci bàyyi saa yu la neexee te doo ñàkk sa liggéey
privacy.promise5: Danuy leer ci li ñuy jël ak luko waral

attachments.subtitle: Taxawal dokimaa yuñ tegaale, yamaleg dayo, ak doxalinu seetlu.
attachments.enableDesc: May yebbi ak indexe ay këyit ngir seet leen.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Tannal ni ñuy yokke dokimaa yuñ jàngat ci waxtaan yi.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Wàllu contexte model bi ñuy jëfandikoo ngir dagg fichier yiñ jàngat ci model lokal yi.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Taalal Aktife Attachment ngir soppi àppu dayo këyit bi.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Dayo bu gëna mag ci këyit bu nekk. Dañu koy jaay doole ci waxtu yebbite ak waxtu liggéey. Nataal yi am nañu seen yam ci kaw.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Dayo bi gëna mag ci nataal bu nekk (JPEG wala PNG). Sa furnisër wala sa model mën nañu tëral àpp bu gëna ndaw.
attachments.topKDesc: Citaasioŋ yu bari yiñ wara delloo.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Njortu nuru bu gëna ndaw (0-1). Seetug kosin ligneer kese lañu koy jëfandikoo, du ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Tannal ci diggante sqlite-vec ANN, kosin ligneer, wala oto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Xeetu araf yu gëna bari ci chunk bu nekk ngir dugal.
attachments.chunkOverlapDesc: Karaktër yiy jaxasoo ci diggante pàcc yu toppalante.
